questions.stem: 讓未滿十六歲的孩子使用社群媒體，比許多家長想像的更傷害孩子的心理健康。
questions.answer: Letting children under the age of 16 use social media is more harmful to their mental health than many parents realize.
accepted_answers: Allowing children younger than 16 to use social media does more harm to their mental health than many parents imagine.
Permitting kids under 16 to use social media is more damaging to their mental health than a lot of parents think.

questions.stem: 社群媒體上充斥著他們不該接觸的內容，迫使許多國家考慮禁止他們開設帳號。
questions.answer: Social media is full of content that they should not be exposed to, forcing many countries to consider banning them from opening accounts.
accepted_answers: Social media is filled with content that they shouldn't have access to, prompting many countries to consider prohibiting them from creating accounts.
Social media platforms are full of content which they should not see, forcing many countries to consider stopping them from setting up accounts.

1.explanation_zh: 中文主詞是「讓未滿十六歲的孩子使用社群媒體」這件事，英文用動名詞片語 Letting children under 16 use social media（或 Allowing … to use …）當主詞，動詞用單數 is。「比許多家長想像的更傷害」是比較級：is more harmful to their mental health than many parents realize，比較對象 than many parents realize／imagine 放在最後。「心理健康」是 mental health。
evidence: 讓未滿十六歲的孩子使用社群媒體
比許多家長想像的更傷害
1.strategy_zh: 先找出真正的主詞（一件事→動名詞），再把「比…更…」整理成 more + adj. + than …。
hints: 切成四段：讓未滿十六歲的孩子使用社群媒體／比許多家長想像的／更傷害／孩子的心理健康
標的詞彙：let（讓，也可用 allow … to）、child（孩子）、social media（社群媒體）、use（使用）、harmful（有害的）、mental（心理的）、health（健康）、parent（家長）、realize（了解；也可用 imagine、think）
句型框架：V-ing … + is more harmful to + N + than + S + realize

2.explanation_zh: 「社群媒體上充斥著…」英文以 social media 當主詞：Social media is full of …（也可用 is filled with）。「他們不該接觸的內容」中文修飾語在前，英文用關係子句後位修飾：content (that) they should not be exposed to，be exposed to 的 to 不能漏，content 這裡不可數。「迫使許多國家考慮…」是前面整件事造成的結果，用句尾分詞 forcing many countries to consider …；consider 後面接動名詞，「禁止他們開設帳號」是 banning them from opening accounts（ban + 人 + from + V-ing）。
evidence: 迫使許多國家考慮禁止他們開設帳號
2.strategy_zh: 中文「……的＋名詞」而修飾語有自己的主詞時，先想受格關係子句；句尾「迫使／造成…」先想逗號＋V-ing。
hints: 切成四段：社群媒體上充斥著／他們不該接觸的內容／迫使許多國家考慮／禁止他們開設帳號
標的詞彙：social media（社群媒體）、full（充滿的）、content（內容）、expose（使接觸）、force（迫使）、country（國家）、consider（考慮）、ban（禁止）、open（開設）、account（帳號）
句型框架：S + is full of + N + (that) + S + should not be exposed to, forcing + O + to consider + V-ing …

traps.zh: 讓未滿十六歲的孩子使用社群媒體
traps.literal_error: Let children under 16 use social media is more harmful to their mental health than many parents realize.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接用「讓孩子使用社群媒體」這件事當主詞，英文要改成動名詞 Letting …；照中文語序以 Let 開頭會變成祈使句。

traps.literal_error: … is more harmful to their psychology health …
traps.explanation_zh: 「心理健康」是複合概念，英文是 mental health；psychology 是名詞「心理學」。

bonus.text: Little do many parents realize how much harm social media can do to the mental health of children under 16.
bonus.explanation_zh: 否定副詞 Little 置首倒裝（Little do + S + realize …）強調「家長渾然不覺」，並用 how much harm 間接問句帶出程度。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 中文以「讓…使用社群媒體」這件事當主題，英文用動名詞主詞 Letting／Allowing …，動詞用單數 is；「比…想像的更傷害…」改成 is more harmful to … than many parents realize，比較對象 than … 放在句尾。
1.notes_zh: 第 3、4 部分也可以寫成 does more harm to their mental health，或 harms their mental health more than …（比較級 more 一樣成立）。寫成 It is more harmful … to let children … 的虛主詞句也算 NFSUBJ（不定詞主詞後移），但較繞口，不列入參考譯文。「未滿十六歲」寫 under 16、under the age of 16、younger than 16 都可以；「想像」寫 realize、imagine、think 都可以。

common_errors.wrong: to ban them from opening accounts
common_errors.explanation_zh: consider 後面接動名詞：consider banning …，不接不定詞。
ban 的句型是 ban + 人 + from + V-ing。

traps.literal_error: Social media is full with content …
traps.explanation_zh: 「充斥著」是 be full of／be filled with，介系詞搭配固定；也不要寫成 On social media is full of …。

traps.zh: 考慮禁止他們開設帳號
traps.literal_error: …, forcing many countries to consider to ban them to open accounts.
traps.explanation_zh: consider 後面接動名詞（consider banning），ban 的句型是 ban + 人 + from + V-ing；照中文「考慮禁止」直譯成 to ban 會錯兩次。

bonus.text: So much of what appears on social media is unfit for children that many countries are now considering barring them from opening accounts.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 so much … that …（如此多…以致於…）把因果關係說得更緊湊，並用 what appears on social media 名詞子句代替「內容」。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「社群媒體上充斥著…」英文直接以 social media 當主詞（is full of …），不要寫 On social media is full of …；「他們不該接觸的內容」修飾語在前，英文改成 content (that) they should not be exposed to；「迫使…」承接前面整件事，用句尾分詞 forcing … to consider …，consider 後面接動名詞 banning。
2.notes_zh: 第 3 部分寫成非限定關係子句 , which has forced／prompted many countries to consider … 一樣表達「前面整件事造成的結果」，算作 PART 的可接受寫法（已列入 accepted）；寫成 so many countries are considering … 是對等子句，不在可接受寫法內。第 1 部分寫成 There is so much content on social media that they should not see 也可以（關係子句仍修飾 content）。「不該接觸」寫 should not be exposed to／should not see／should not have access to 都可以；寫成 content that is not suitable for them 也是關係子句，接受。

1.translation: Allowing children under sixteen to use social media is more harmful to their mental health than many parents imagine.
1.explanation_zh: 「讓…使用」用動名詞主詞 Allowing … to use；「比許多家長想像的更傷害」用比較級 more harmful to … than many parents imagine。

2.translation: Social media is filled with content that they should not be exposed to, forcing many countries to consider banning them from opening accounts.
2.explanation_zh: 「充斥著」用 be filled with；「他們不該接觸的內容」用關係子句 that they should not be exposed to；「迫使」用分詞構句 forcing … to；consider 後接動名詞，ban sb from V-ing。they／them 指前句未滿十六歲的孩子。

1.translation: Allowing children under sixteen to use social media does more harm to their mental health than many parents imagine.
1.explanation_zh: 主詞是動名詞片語 Allowing ... to use ...，動詞用 does more harm to ... than ... 表示「比……更傷害」；「許多家長想像的」放在 than 之後，省略重複的 harm。

2.translation: Social media is full of content that they should not be exposed to, forcing many countries to consider banning them from opening accounts.
2.explanation_zh: 「充斥著」用 be full of；「他們不該接觸的內容」用關係子句 that they should not be exposed to；「迫使……考慮禁止……」用分詞構句 forcing ... to consider banning ... from + V-ing。
